Roman Kemp presents a guide to the weekend's action, with guests, interviews and expert opinion around the Premier League's big talking points.

Stoke City v Preston North End (Kick-off 12.30pm). All the action from the Championship match at bet365 Stadium. Last season's corresponding fixture ended goalless, before Preston claimed a 3-1 win later in the campaign at Deepdale, but Stoke will be favourites in this match given their superior form so far this term.
Reports on the afternoon's football up and down the country, as goals go in and updates arrive in the studio from around the ground.

Tottenham Hotspur v Crystal Palace (Kick-off 5.30pm). Coverage of the Premier League match at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Spurs took the lead in last season's corresponding fixture courtesy of Dominic Solanke, but things soon took a turn for the worse for them when Micky van de Ven was sent off, with Palace going on to win 3-1 thanks to a brace by Ismaila Sarr and a strike from Jorgen Strand Larsen.

Aston Villa v Fulham (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the Premier League match at Villa Park. The hosts claimed a 3-1 win when the teams met here last term, with Raul Jimenez giving the visitors an early lead, but the Villans fighting back through Ollie Watkins, John McGinn and Emiliano Buendia. They will be expecting another three points this evening against a Fulham side that have found wins hard to come by so far this season.

Liverpool v Arsenal (Kick-off 4.30pm). All the action from the Premier League match at Anfield. A stunning free-kick from Dominik Szoboszlai gave Liverpool a 1-0 win in last season's corresponding fixture. However, it was Arsenal who went on to succeed the Reds as champions, and they have also made the stronger start to the current campaign so will have high hopes of a first win here since 2012.

The ATP Paris Masters. Coverage of day one of the ATP Masters event, a hard-court tournament at La Défense Arena in France, featuring first-round matches. Jannik Sinner was the champion. The top eight seeds receive a bye to the second round and the highest-ranked casualty in round one 12 months ago was 14th seed Ji?í Lehe?ka, who was beaten 6-1, 6-3 by wildcard Valentin Vacherot. Félix Auger-Aliassime was the eventual runner-up to Jannik Sinner and he got his tournament under way at this stage by overcoming qualifier Francisco Comesaña 6-7, 6-3, 6-3.

Newcastle United v Everton (Kick-off 8.00pm). All the action from the Premier League match at St James' Park. Everton claimed victory here for the second successive season last term, with Thierno Barry scoring an 83rd-minute winner moments after Jacob Murphy had equalised for Newcastle. The Toffees have also avoided defeat in their first three away games of the current campaign, though all of them ended in draws.

The ATP Paris Masters. Coverage of day two of the ATP Masters event, a hard-court tournament at La Défense Arena in France, featuring matches in the first and second rounds. Great Britain's Cameron Norrie enjoyed an excellent victory in round two last year, prevailing 4-6, 6-3, 6-4 against then world number one Carlos Alcaraz. There was also a 6-7, 6-1, 7-5 victory for third seed Alexander Zverev against Camilo Ugo Carabelli.

West Bromwich Albion v Southampton (Kick-off 8.00pm). All the action from the Championship match at The Hawthorns, as the two former Premier League teams go head to head. The visitors picked up four points in the league against their hosts last season, including a thrilling 3-2 victory at home in December. The meeting at this ground last year sat Cyle Larin score a 91st-minute equaliser for the Saints to earn a 1-1 draw.
